label: 愛 · 不二
title: 愛 ↔ 不二 · Maitrādvaita
subtitle: Original interpretation
evidence: Proposed reading: loving-kindness may be how non-duality is lived — when self and other are not two, care need not be earned or rationed.
caveat: Rushi’s original proposal, not an attested Sanskrit term or a canonical definition of non-duality. Maitrādvaita is a creative name; the attested Buddhist correspondence here is 不二 / advaya. 慈, rather than 愛, is the usual rendering of maitrī. The name does not equate Buddhist advaya with Advaita Vedānta.
